look_here_first: Creeping or floating mat of alternate glossy broad leaves, with typically 5 showy yellow petals and 10 stamens.

key_traits.label: Habit
key_traits.text: Aquatic perennial with floating or creeping stems often rooting at nodes.

key_traits.label: Leaves
key_traits.text: Alternate or fascicled; usually shiny elliptic to obovate petiolate blades.

key_traits.label: Flower
key_traits.text: Typically 5 broad yellow petals and 10 stamens; flower borne in leaf axil.

key_traits.label: Fruit
key_traits.text: Cylindrical or slightly angular capsule, usually thicker-walled; details vary across geographic subspecies.
